tools.description: Suggests bench employees (allocation = "On Bench") who match the given employee’s skill profile. **Input:** - `employee_name` (str): Name of the employee to find similar bench profiles for. - `match_level` (str): One of `"strict"`, `"partial"`, or `"none"`: - `"strict"` = Match in all 4 skill dimensions. - `"partial"` = Match in at least 2 of 4 dimensions. - `"none"` = Match in fewer than 2 dimensions. **Returns:** A dictionary with: - `bench_matches`: Dictionary of up to 5 employee profiles who are on bench. **Example Response:** { "bench_matches": { "Neha Kapoor": { "role": "Architect", "cloud_experties": "Azure", "cloud_native_experties": "Fivetran", "dw_experties": "Databricks", "domain_exposure": "Retail", "allocation": "On Bench" }, "Rahul Desai": { "role": "DE", "cloud_experties": "AWS", "cloud_native_experties": "Glue", "dw_experties": "Redshift", "domain_exposure": "Healthcare", "allocation": "On Bench" } } }
